specification.title: Earlier-section conditional-frequency permutation bank
specification.status: specified speculative proposal; unrun; eligibility conditional
specification.evidence_grade: Earlier sections are real independent data; the proposed statistical use is invented and explicitly unattributed.
specification.mechanism: Build a static alphabet permutation for each previous-plaintext letter from bigram frequencies in K1-K3. The previous decoded letter selects the next row. This is a fixed finite-context substitution bank, not a keyword search, adaptive count model, or ordinary running key.

forward_model.source: Freeze one baseline-consistent transcription of the solved as-carved K1, K2, and K3 plaintexts; preserve their literal spelling, X separators and as-carved K2 ending, strip nonletters, and count bigrams WITHIN each section, not across artificial concatenation boundaries. Do not sweep corrected/uncorrected editions.
forward_model.table: For a,b in AZ, n[a,b] is the number of within-section occurrences of ab. L_a is AZ sorted by descending n[a,b], ties by AZ order. Thus every L_a is a permutation, even when a never occurs. No learned numerical weights or fitted entries.
forward_model.state: s_0 is the final literal letter of K3. For each input plaintext P_i, emit C_i=AZ[index(L_s,P_i)] and set s=P_i.
forward_model.inverse: At state s, P_i=L_s[index(AZ,C_i)]; then s=P_i. Each row is a permutation, so encryption and decryption are sequential and exact.
forward_model.alignment: Exactly one plaintext letter per ciphertext letter, no resets at public clues, global stream begins at i=0. All public plaintext positions retain their ordinary global indices.
forward_model.finite_domain: One source policy, one deterministic bank, one fixed initial state, one AZ output convention, one 97-symbol model. No alphabet/phase/keyword/normalization sweep. If source ambiguity cannot be resolved independently, status becomes evidence-blocked rather than a source-choice search.

specification.measurable_prediction: The independently built 26-row bank determines exactly one complete decryption and full re-encryption. A disagreement at any disclosed plaintext position falsifies this exact model. The empirical rows and all decoded symbols are fixed without fitting to K4.

Its source is not a negative for E01. Ordinary additive autokey has cyclic/conjugate row structure; E01 permits independently noncyclic rows. Unlike a literal earlier-section running key, E01 reads a conditional frequency table, not one successive source character. Unlike A02's adaptive transition-count proposal, E01 never updates counts.

specification.mechanism: At a moving cursor on a circular earlier-section text, the order in which distinct letters next appear supplies a complete substitution alphabet. Encrypt a letter by its rank in that order, then move the cursor past that letter's first encountered occurrence. The reference text is immutable, but cursor travel is plaintext-dependent.

forward_model.source: Use the same single independently frozen as-carved K1-K3 plaintext normalization as E01. Concatenate in section order, then append each AZ letter absent from the whole reference exactly once in AZ order. This completion convention is a disclosed design choice, not a clue. Call the resulting finite circular string R of length N.
forward_model.alphabet_at_state: At cursor q, scan at most one full circuit of R and retain each letter only at its first encounter. The resulting A_q is a permutation of AZ. Let d(q,p) be the least nonnegative distance to an occurrence of p.
forward_model.state: q_0=0. Emit C_i=AZ[index(A_q,P_i)] and set q'=(q+d(q,P_i)+1) mod N.
forward_model.inverse: P_i=A_q[index(AZ,C_i)], then use the same first-occurrence rule to update q. The output rank uniquely selects a letter at each state, so the entire stream is invertible.
forward_model.alignment: One plaintext symbol becomes one ciphertext symbol. There are no clue-boundary resets, padding, deleted symbols, or unknown processed indices.

specification.mechanism: View the 97-letter word as a trail of 96 directed edges between its letter labels; retain start s and end t. For each vertex v list successors in visit order. specification.title: Euclidean-quotient reversal on bounded integer pairs
specification.mechanism: For each four-letter block, split into two two-letter base-26 integers plus one, so u,v are in 1..676. Retain which slot contains A=max(u,v) and let B=min(u,v). If A/B<2 leave the pair unchanged. Otherwise divide by g=gcd(A,B), compute the canonical regular continued fraction of A/B with last quotient >=2 unless it is a singleton, reverse its quotient list, and reconstruct the reduced fraction A0/B0prime. Continuant symmetry preserves A0=A/g. Output A in its original larger slot and g*B0prime in the other; subtract one and render two letters each. Pass final singleton unchanged. This is an involution: reversed first/last quotients stay >=2, the guard stays true, numerator/gcd/orientation remain fixed, and reversing again restores the pair.
